notes: ACCESS: direct curl_cffi (probe.fetch) reached every URL, HTTP 200, no WAF - same as the prior Home-Decor pass. TREE: uk/sitemap_Category.xml (365 loc entries) cross-checked against each page's server-rendered window.universal_variable.page.breadcrumb / .category, which gives the site's own display name and true parent chain. The Furniture department is https://www.thewhitecompany.com/uk/Home/c/furniture (breadcrumb Home > Furniture) and its live children are: Beds, Mattresses & Divans; Mattresses; Coffee & Side Tables; Benches, Stools & Pouffes; Armchairs; Cabinets; plus the two facet nodes New In Furniture and Stocked Furniture. WebFetch's rendered read of the Furniture page listed the same sub-nav (Armchairs, Coffee & Side Tables, Beds Mattresses & Divans, Sofas and Armchairs, Benches Stools & Pouffes, Cabinets, Children's Furniture). QTY METHOD: this is SAP Hybris; every category URL exposes its own listing JSON at <category-url>/results?q=%3Arelevance&page=0 whose pagination.totalNumberOfResults is the number the rendered grid header prints. Validated against the rendered header twice via WebFetch: Furniture parent API 106 vs rendered 'Showing 48 of 106'; Beds API 40 vs rendered 'Showing 40 of 40'; Coffee & Side Tables API 15 vs rendered 'Showing 15 of 15'. Numbers vary per category (40/15/11/5/0), not a site-wide constant, and a control read of two non-furniture nodes gave different values again (Mirrors 10, Lighting 43). Every leaf was read twice ~15 min apart with identical totals - no drift. Note the SSR 'initialItems' blob used by the prior Home-Decor pass over-counts by including non-product content tiles (the Beds grid carries a 'Beds Buying Guide' tile, giving 41 vs the true 40); the API total correctly excludes them, so the API total was used. FULL-DEPARTMENT CHECK: enumerated all 106 items of the Furniture department across its 3 API pages - the only product types present are beds/headboards/divan bases, mattresses, side/console/coffee/bedside tables, stools/benches/pouffes, sheepskin armchairs, children's beds and one children's bookshelf, plus lighting and mirrors. There are no desks, dining tables, wardrobes, chests of drawers, sideboards or media units anywhere in the catalogue, which corroborates Cabinets = 0. STALE SITEMAP SLUGS DROPPED: /Home/Furniture/c/bedroom-furniture, /chest-of-drawers, /bathroom-cabinets-and-units and /wardrobes-and-storage all return HTTP 200 but serve the PARENT Furniture listing - identical 48-item grid, title 'Home Furniture', breadcrumb ['Home','Furniture'] and rel=canonical pointing at /Home/c/furniture. They are dead nodes, not real categories (exactly the Magento/Hybris silent-parent-fallback trap), so none were recorded. EXCLUDED: Mattresses (/Home/Furniture/c/mattresses-and-divans, 5 items, all Hypnos mattresses) - mattresses are bedding, not furniture; New In Furniture (40) and Stocked Furniture (19) - New-In / fulfilment facet pages; the nine /uk/Furniture-Collections/* pages (Classic, Padstow, Sloane, Suffolk, Charlton, Beaufort, Thurloe, Malham & Brunel, Sheepskin) - marketing collection pages; /uk/Sale/c/furniture-sale and /uk/Offers/c/furniture-offers - sale/offer pages; Beanbags (/Home/Home-Furnishings/c/beanbags, 3 items) - filed under Home Furnishings with rugs and cushions, and all three items (Sheepskin Round Pouffe, Cosy Sheepskin Pouffe, Sheepskin Tall Pouffe) are already inside the Benches, Stools & Pouffes count, so recording it would duplicate; Nursery (15 items, but 6 baby blankets + 3 bed linen + gift sets/toys/duvets and only 2 furniture items) - primary product type is textiles; the SEO landing pages /uk/c/foot-stool-cs and /uk/c/bookshelfs-cs (both 0 products); Home Accessories, Kitchen & Dining, Bathroom (bath mats/accessories/towels/wash bags - no vanity units or cabinets), Home Furnishings and Bedroom departments contain no furniture nodes. LEGITIMATE ZEROES KEPT: Cabinets and Garden Furniture are real, currently-linked category nodes whose own API reports totalNumberOfResults = 0 (empty grid, numberOfPages 0) - reported as 0 rather than dropped.
